Plan a 3-day trip to Petra on a budget

Day 1: Arrive in Wadi Musa, check into a family guesthouse (~$30) and catch Petra by Night. Day 2: Enter early — the Siq, the Treasury, then hike up to the Monastery before noon heat. Day 3: Little Petra in the morning, then a Bedouin dinner. Total: about $210 including the 2-day pass.
